subject.title: feat(ui): create catalog sessions from the sidebar

question: Should session catalog providers permanently advertise a core new-session target through `createSession`, with eligibility determined by the default agent’s resolved runtime policy?
rationale: The implementation is internally consistent and well tested, but it creates a new plugin/protocol API and selects a product policy that excludes valid non-default-agent runtimes; only maintainers can confirm that permanent boundary.

options.title: Approve current contract
options.body: Accept the additive provider capability and default-agent runtime gate, then refresh and merge the branch against current main.

options.title: Name an explicit target
options.body: Revise the capability to identify an explicit eligible agent or runtime target instead of deriving eligibility from the default agent.

options.title: Narrow the feature
options.body: Land only agent-scoped sidebar creation and duplicate-row presentation, deferring provider-native catalog creation until the API direction is settled.

recommendation.title: Approve current contract
recommendation.body: Accept the additive provider capability and default-agent runtime gate, then refresh and merge the branch against current main.
